title: Category and Vendor show their names, and an em dash ("—") when the part has none
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows a part with a category and a vendor, a part with no category, and a part with no vendor.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Category and Vendor cells of the fully-populated part.
2. Read the Category cell of the part with no category.
3. Read the Vendor cell of the part with no vendor.
custom_expected:
1. Category shows the part's category name; Vendor shows the part's vendor name.
2. A part with no category shows an em dash ("—") in its Category cell.
3. A part with no vendor shows an em dash ("—") in its Vendor cell.
